name: Queensland (Australia, governor's standard)
description: The Union Flag defaced in the centre with the Queensland badge — a crowned light blue Maltese cross on white — within a green garland.

features.role: Queensland badge: a light blue Maltese cross ensigned with a royal crown, within a garland

history: Alone among the Australian states, Queensland retained the British colonial model of a defaced Union Flag rather than adopting a crowned state flag in the 1970s and 1980s.
